description: Mint a fine-grained repository token (`gcft_…`) for ONE repository and return it once. It authenticates the REST API (/api/v2 and the GitHub-compatible /api/v3), git over HTTPS and the container registry (images under owner/repo, by contents) for that repository only. `permissions` sets none/read/write for contents, issues, pull_requests, statuses and actions (admin and settings are never grantable); `expires_in` is optional: omit it (or "never") for no expiration, or give seconds or "30m", "12h", "7d", "1y" (min 5 minutes, max 1 year). Effective access is always held to YOUR current access to the repo, re-checked on every use, and branch protection applies as it does to you. Needs 'repo' scope. Audit-logged. Returns {id, name, repository, permissions, expiresAt, tokenPrefix, token}.

expires_in.description: Optional lifetime: "30m" / "12h" / "7d" / "1y", or a number of seconds (5 minutes to 1 year). Omit, or "never", for no expiration.

name.description: Where the token will be used, e.g. 'gatetest deploy box'

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

permissions.description: Object of level per permission — keys contents, issues, pull_requests, statuses, actions, runners; values none | read | write (runners: none | read only — it lists the owner's CI runners via GET /api/v2/repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runners and reads nothing of the repository); omitted keys are none; at least one must be read or write. Example: {"actions": "read"}, or {"runners": "read"} for a runner audit.

name: gluecron_create_repo_token
